separation_note: DeepSeek-only policy (DEC-5): deepseek-v4-pro is the sole approved model for both DUT and judge. Separation is by role, not model: judge calls run under a separate purpose (kind='judge'), over blind A/B arms with deterministic position swap, and draw from the same crash-safe budget ledger and owner-approved cap as benchmark calls. A malformed judge verdict fails the judgment (ProviderCallFailed), never a silent tie.
